Garciloga nació en octubre de 2026 en Ci: Garciloga was founded in October 2026 in Mexico City by Isaac López García, after years working in Customer Success, Onboarding and Account Management at technology and SaaS companies.
Empezó con el nombre CodeZero, como una: It began as CodeZero, a platform for learning programming from scratch: 15 levels, 92 lessons, exercises, exams and Capstone projects. It soon became clear that programming was only part of the picture: people also need to learn processes, make decisions and prepare for roles such as Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Account Management, Project Management and leadership.
El 7 de octubre de 2026 la plataforma to: On October 7, 2026, the platform adopted its final name, Garciloga, and broadened its direction. Today it is available in Spanish, English, Portuguese and French, with a company workspace where each leader tracks their team's progress.
